notes: The music video stays on the size you asked for. A dropped connection used to be treated as the size being wrong, so a signal that was busy for a second could take a 1080p picture down to 360p. The same size now starts again at the second it was on, and only a phone that actually refuses the picture steps down.

A big size is given the time it needs. The check that watched for a size that never started called it at nine seconds, which is the smallest row budget - a 1080p picture was given up while it was still fetching its bytes. The wait now grows with the size, and a picture that is still loading, or that has already buffered something, is left alone.
When a size is given up, the footer says which size it went to and why, so a smaller picture is never a mystery.
